description: Read ONE captured request by its id (from get_network_requests): method, URL, status, whether a mock produced it, request and response headers (secrets redacted) and the full bodies up to maxChars, plus a one-line shape of the response (array lengths included) so counts don't depend on reading a long body. Use this instead of re-listing requests with includeBodies when you need one response.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

maxChars.description: Most body characters to show per body. Default 12000.

name: get_network_request
